sail.racing.name: Racing Sail
sail.racing.does: Faster at the top, slower to get there.

sail.storm.name: Storm Sail
sail.storm.does: Quick off the line, a lower top.

keel.grind.name: Grind Keel
keel.grind.does: A steadier rail, a looser carve.

keel.deep.name: Deep Keel
keel.deep.does: Holds the sand, wobbles on a rail.

hull.light.name: Light Hull
hull.light.does: Light off the line, light in a bump.

hull.heavy.name: Heavy Hull
hull.heavy.does: Hits like a kiln door, slow to wind up.

mast.tall.name: Tall Mast
mast.tall.does: More sail up high: faster, and twitchier on a rail and a landing.

mast.short.name: Short Mast
mast.short.does: Quick to fill and steady, a lower top.

fin.surf.name: Surf Fin
fin.surf.does: Loads a carve quickly; lets go of the sand sooner.

fin.race.name: Race Fin
fin.race.does: Holds the sand hard; a carve loads slowly.
